title: Sustainable valorization of tea flower (Camellia sinensis) blossoms: bioactive phytochemicals and functional food applications – a review
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00645G, Review Article

Pratyasha Gogoi, Tapasya Kumari, Sai Babu, C. Nickhil, Sankar Chandra Deka
The tea flower blossom is a by-product of tea plant cultivation, which has enormous potential for development as a sustainable resource. They are rich in phytochemical constituents such as polyphenols, saponins, flavonoids, and polysaccharides.
